description: This PHP source file defines the PayGradeAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing Pay Grade entities in an HRM system. It includes actions for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting pay grade records, along with validation rules, documentation comments with OpenAPI annotations, and integration with service and data access layers.

classes.name: PayGradeAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class that handles CRUD operations for Pay Grade entities in the HRM system, providing endpoints for listing, creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion, with validation and OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all pay grades, applying sorting and pagination parameters, and returning a collection of PayGradeModels with meta information.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new pay grade entity, validating input and returning the created model.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete specified pay grades by their IDs, returning the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific pay grade by ID, returning its model representation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing pay grade identified by ID, validating input and returning the updated model.

methods.name: savePayGrade
methods.description: Utility method to populate and save a PayGrade entity with data from request parameters.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides validation rules for request bodies, including enforcement of unique name constraint with optional ignore ID for updates.
